panel.label: Token Monitor
panel.title: Token Cost Monitor
panel.help: Read-only monitoring of DSH token usage and cost: four buckets (cache-miss input / cache read / cache write / output), cache hit rate, per-task cost and anomaly analysis. All data stays local in DSH_HOME/dsh-token-manager and is never uploaded. Phase 1 only analyses: it never rewrites context or limits model calls.

error.network: Network unavailable; check that the local service is running

help.todayTokens: Total tokens since local midnight (sum of the four buckets).
help.sessionTokens: Total tokens of the active session; falls back to the most recent session when no session id is supplied.
help.taskTokens: Total tokens of the latest turn (auto task).
help.cacheHitRate: Cache hit rate = cache-read tokens ÷ (cache-read + cache-miss input).
help.missInput: Cache-miss input tokens: the newly sent part that did not hit the prompt cache.
help.output: Total model output tokens; reasoning tokens are tracked separately.
help.calls: Number of model calls in the range (deduplicated final records per turn/step).
help.cost: Locally estimated from the price table, not a real bill. When no price is configured this shows “Price not configured” instead of 0.
help.findings: Findings produced by tasks in the range (repeated read, repeated build, step inflation, cost anomaly, …).
help.trend: Daily aggregates: line = total tokens, bars = calls. Switch between 7 and 30 days.
help.rankTasks: Token ranking by task; click a task to open its cost report.
help.allTime: Total tokens across all history, including sessions imported from the projection cache.

overview.empty: No calls yet — run one model call and data appears here

calls.empty: No calls recorded yet — they appear after the next model call

tasks.empty: No tasks yet — a conversation turn creates one automatically

help.subview: Tasks and Projects are two sub-views inside the same tab: tasks are created per turn, projects aggregate by working directory. Switching sub-views never changes the seven top-level tabs.
help.create: Create a task manually: the name is required, the type decides the baseline it compares against, and the session defaults to the latest active one.
help.merge: Merging folds the selected tasks into one; calls and cost statistics merge too. Only tasks from the same session can be merged.

tasks.mergeHint: Select two or more tasks from the same session to merge
tasks.selectOneForExport: Select exactly one task before exporting
tasks.helpList: Tasks are created per turn. Type and status can be edited directly in the table; click any row to open the detail drawer, and select tasks to merge or export a report.

report.empty: Select a task above to see its cost report
report.notFound: This task has no cost data

help.percentile: Percentile against the same task-type baseline (0–100, higher means costlier). Empty when there are too few samples.
help.baseline: Median and p80 of completed tasks with the same project and task type. No conclusion below 5 samples.
help.findings: Read-only analysis results: repeated reads, repeated build/test, step inflation, cache drop, cost anomaly, etc. Each check can be disabled in Settings.
help.topCalls: The costliest model calls of this task with the reason (large input / low cache hit / large output / retry).
help.suggestions: Suggestions only, never executed automatically. Phase 1 performs no intervention.

report.baselineInsufficient: Not enough samples for a baseline conclusion

settings.resetConfirm: Reset all settings to their defaults?

help.capture: The capture switch controls whether usage is recorded. Observe-only keeps analysis non-intervening. The evidence limit caps how much text findings may keep.
help.analytics: Each analysis can be disabled individually; disabling it stops that finding type from being produced.
help.thresholds: Numeric thresholds used by the checks; changes take effect immediately.
help.prices: Configure the four bucket prices per provider + model. The unit is the billing unit (default 1,000,000 tokens). Costs are local estimates, not real bills.
help.data: The projection-cache import is read-only and never modifies sessions. CSV export includes a UTF-8 BOM and formula-injection escaping.
help.compression: Compresses long tool results and replaces them with a summary to save context tokens. Replacements are written to the session log (visible in history), while the full original stays in a local blob and can be restored any time. Observe mode records and stores without replacing what the model sees. Phase 2 defaults to observe mode.
help.context: Detect only, never rewrite. Analyses duplicate content in the current context and estimates savings versus KV-cache risk; dry-run by default. Thresholds and the risk factor drive candidate and risk decisions; when no price is configured the cache-read ratio estimates risk cost.

settings.pricesEmpty: No prices yet — add one to estimate costs

compression.clearConfirm: Clear the entire tool output cache? This cannot be undone.

help.entries: Number of raw tool outputs recorded (repeated calls count separately; dedupe hits are counted on their own).
help.original: Sum of the original bytes of every cached tool output.
help.compressed: Sum of the compressed bytes actually written to disk.
help.saved: Estimated saving = original size − compressed size (bytes and percentage). This estimates disk usage, not billing savings.
help.table: Cached tool outputs newest first. Click any row to read the original text. “Not recoverable” means the blob file was pruned or is missing.
help.viewer: The drawer reads the local original blob 8 KB at a time with previous/next paging. It is read-only and never modifies sessions or cache content.

cache.empty: No cached tool outputs yet — one large tool output records automatically

viewer.title: Tool output source
viewer.notRecoverable: The original blob is missing or was pruned, so it cannot be shown.
viewer.emptyContent: This segment has no content to show.

help.page: Detect only, never rewrite. This page analyses duplicate content and KV-cache risk in the current context and defaults to dry-run. Rewriting context breaks the cached prefix, which usually costs more than the tokens saved, so Phase 3 ships no automatic rewriting. “Record dry-run suggestions” only writes candidates to local records and never touches the session.
help.nodes: Surface nodes = number of messages or segments in this request context (system / developer / user / assistant / tool).
help.tokens: Context tokens estimated from character counts, not an official billing figure.
help.candidates: Removable duplicated content items; a contentHash must reach the minimum occurrence threshold to be counted.
help.savings: Estimated tokens saved if every candidate were removed; the extra cost of an invalidated KV cache is not deducted.
help.composition: Context share by role and by source. Protected sources (system / user / dsh-mnemon …) can never become removal candidates.
help.candidateTable: Click a candidate row to expand where it appears (turn / step / seq / tokens). The risk badge shows safe / risky / unknown plus the reason.
help.history: History of recorded dry-run suggestions. Local records only; nothing is ever rewritten.

context.emptySession: This session has no analysable context yet — send a turn, then refresh
context.emptyHistory: No dry-run records yet — use the button above to record one

taskdetail.title: Task detail
taskdetail.help: This drawer summarises the task metrics, the nine summary fields, write/command aggregation, findings and call details. “Auto-generated (local)” means the text came from a local draft; saving turns it into an edited version. Exports read local data only.
taskdetail.notFound: Task not found or has no detail data
taskdetail.name: Task name
taskdetail.summaryHelp: The nine summary fields record the objective, output and next steps of the task. They stay in the local database and can be exported as JSON/Markdown/CSV; nothing is written to the session log or mnemon.
taskdetail.helpWrites: Aggregates files written and commands executed by this task, grouped by tool and target, for reviewing the actual change scope.
taskdetail.emptyWrites: No file or command changes yet
taskdetail.helpFindings: Read-only analysis results for this task (repeated reads, repeated builds, step inflation, cost anomalies …).
taskdetail.helpCalls: Lists the model calls of this task by time, up to 50 rows. Use the Calls tab filtered by task for the full list.

projects.title: Projects

help.list: Projects aggregate sessions and tasks by working directory. The summary status shows whether a saved summary version exists; draft suggestions are generated locally.

projects.empty: No projects yet — they appear after the first conversation

editor.title: Project summary
editor.help: The eight project summary sections are stored locally to record the project state and constraints. Drafts are generated locally; saving an edited version creates a new version with an incremented number and replaces the previous draft. Nothing is written to mnemon or the session log.
editor.draftHint: These are locally generated draft suggestions; save to create a version
editor.helpDraft: Draft suggestions are local reference text; applying fills the sections, and saving is still required.

live.referenceNone: No matching reference price — set it manually in Settings
live.hint: Live counters: today / session tokens, estimated tokens saved by compression, and cost. Local data, refreshed every 5s.
